milestone: M7 — Cross-Solver Near-Field Comparison and Hybrid Coupling Design
study_site: Bhavanisagar Dam / Lower Bhavani Dam, Tamil Nadu

forcing_differences.dflow_fm: Continuous time-varying discharge boundary representing the complete BHV_BASE hydrograph (30 hr, Qpeak=18,742.38 m3/s at t=14,095.59 s)
forcing_differences.dualsphysics: Finite initialized peak-state fluid block (H=17.526 m, L=400 m, unit-width release, duration=600 s)

normalization_method: h_star = h / h_100m, u_star = u / u_100m, x_star = chainage / 1500m
timing_limitation: Fundamentally different time references; no percentage timing error calculated; treated as SCENARIO_RESPONSE_CONTEXT

trend_assessment.velocity_trend_explanation: SPH shows strong attenuation after the near-dam jet region, whereas D-Flow depth-averaged peak velocity increases farther downstream in the sampled reach. This is not solver error because forcing and dimensional formulations are non-equivalent.

front_propagation_status.notes: SPH front reached 1280.41 m by 600 s and the 1500 m station was NOT_REACHED_WITHIN_600_S. It was slowing substantially but was still advancing.
